completion_criteria.text: hooks/lib/pre-tool-use.mjs inverted to deny-by-default inside a protected root: any resolvable token under a protected root DENIES unless the segment head is on an explicit read-only allowlist. shell-tokens.mjs left unchanged.

Both directions proven by committed tests: all 12 verified evasions (including `( rm -rf <root> )` and `sudo rm -rf <root>`) assert DENY, and the 41-command read-only corpus asserts ALLOW. Red-before/green-after evidence recorded.
The scanSegments blow-up resolved so the guard fails CLOSED on oversized or pathological input, never open, with a test asserting the fail-closed path at the boundary.
Full plugin test suite green on the branch, and a fresh code-reviewer plus security-reviewer pass over the final diff returns no CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

Branch merged to main, plugin published to the marketplace, and re-installed globally - then a live end-to-end check against the real store shows a real evasion DENIED and ordinary read commands still ALLOWED.

spine.active_goal: 18 commits on fix/pre-tool-use-guard above b60ac56, suite 735/735 green (independently verified), nothing pushed or merged. Criteria 1 and 2 are MET. Criterion 4 FAILED TWICE: both re-reviews over f95bdcb..HEAD returned BLOCK with 3 CRITICAL + 4 HIGH, each demonstrated by executing the payload. All PRIOR findings are confirmed closed; the new holes sit in code the hardening round added, plus environment assignments - a surface neither pass had inspected.
spine.next_step: ROUND C, then a THIRD re-review. RED corpus first, pinning MECHANISMS not strings. (1) fail closed on unbalanced quotes - CRITICAL-1, no tokenizer change needed; (2) inspect env assignments and env -S - CRITICAL-2/3; (3) scope from UNSPLIT tokens per 0025; (4) bare-dash operand, long-option abbreviation, sort --compress-program; (5) symlink-then-dotdot canonicalization; (6) O1 cleared-gating, git globals restore plus inert-key allowlist. Do NOT merge.
open_risks: CRITICAL-1 unterminated quote fails OPEN: an unmatched single quote reads as quoted-to-end-of-input, so ANSI-C quoting and hash comments swallow every later separator into one token under a cleared head. Fix: fail closed on unbalanced quotes. Needs NO tokenizer change.

CRITICAL-2 env -S: skipPrefixOperands eats the whole -S payload as a flag, the index runs off the end, and normalizeHead returns assignment-only, which is treated as CLEARED. assignment-only must mean every word matched ASSIGNMENT.

CRITICAL-3 env assignments are skipped without inspection. PATH=/tmp cat ROOT/f was verified to DESTROY a stand-in ledger. The same gap reopens the -c escape via GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE, GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF, GIT_PAGER and RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH.
HIGH: bare dash counts as a flag, so uniq - ROOT/f and xxd - ROOT/f leave the ledger path as the OUTPUT operand; all four forms wrote the target. Exclude only /^-./ and handle a bare double-dash.

HIGH: sort accepts any unambiguous long-option prefix, so --out= and --outp= both wrote the file; --compress-program hands its value to sh. Sweep abbreviation across every long-option predicate; file --comp leaks too. git rejects abbreviations itself.

HIGH: isUnderRoot calls resolve() BEFORE canonicalizing, collapsing dotdot lexically while POSIX resolves the symlink first, so link/../PROJECT.md escapes. The symlinked-ROOT direction works, so the fix is half-complete.

HIGH and MY ERROR, see 0025: the mixed-ampersand residual is fail-OPEN, not fail-closed - shredding destroys the root substring, removing scope. Fix by scoping on UNSPLIT tokens. Do NOT use boundary-only splitting; it reopens E5.

MED: O1 drops git/find by NAME, so cat ROOT/f plus git push, git init, git hash-object -w or find -delete went from ask to ALLOW while rm still asks. Gate on whether the other unit is CLEARED instead.

MED: removing -c, -p, --paginate, --namespace, --super-prefix from the git globals hard-DENIES legitimate reads like git -C ROOT -c color.ui=false log. GIT_CFG_BENIGN only appears to pin this - it names no root.

MED: GIT_EXEC_CONFIG_KEY misses pager.SUB, alias.NAME, gpg.program, credential.helper, core.gitProxy, uploadpack.packObjectsHook, core.fsmonitor, init.templateDir, include.path, filter.CLEAN. Invert to an inert-key allowlist.

MED: the unbounded deny fires before the scope gate with a reason claiming the command targets the store when it does not; it needs its own BASH_REASONS entry. Corpus why fields also mix conventions and three cite the deleted sedAllows.

TEST GAP: grep across test/ for dollar-quote, hash-quote, env -S, split-string, PATH=, GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF, GIT_CONFIG_, uniq dash, xxd dash, compress-program, dotdot and LD_PRELOAD returns ZERO hits. Green proves only that FIXED vectors stay fixed.

NEEDS AN EMPIRICAL CHECK: the H6 fix is correct as code but depends on the harness reporting a cwd that tracks intra-session cd. Docs say it does; nobody proved it live. If the harness always reports the project dir, the fix is inert.

LOW: isUnderRoot now THROWS on a non-string root where it returned false; latency hits 630 ms on an 8000-ampersand in-cap command because canonicalPath re-walks per root per token; shell-source.mjs duplicates the frozen tokenizer's quote logic.

PROCESS LESSON, twice burned: a corpus case has twice asserted a hole closed while the mechanism stayed open. Pin mechanisms, not the strings that first exposed them; treat any residual labelled fail-closed as unproven until shown by execution.
Scope inheritance (0022) is CONFIRMED load-bearing but INTRA-SEGMENT only: ls ROOT semicolon rm -rf dollar-D lands on ask via the overlay, not deny.
RED evidence reachable at b60ac56 (657/608/49) and c3f8137 (715/688/27). Do NOT squash.
Design spec sits in a DELIBERATELY GITIGNORED path; 0018, 0020, 0022, 0023 and 0025 carry the content. Tracking it needs git add -f against policy - a USER CALL.

OPEN, unauthorized: M8 ancestor deletion (rm -rf of the CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA root kills every project's ledger), L9 per-call git subprocess in a 10s budget, the deferred roots-length-zero bypass, a flaky gpg fixture.
UNAUTHORIZED DEFECT, do not fix without explicit go: the Stop hook nags every turn (stop.mjs exits 2 unconditionally, never reads stop_hook_active).
